text:
**Legal compliance cannot be determined from this evidence alone.** The assessment makes no regulatory or compliance finding.

No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 hectares or more was detected on the property between 2021 and 2025. However, 0.4 hectares of loss in smaller patches was recorded in 2021, and smaller or narrow changes may be missed. Tree-cover loss was also recorded before the 2020 baseline, including 67.7 hectares in 2020.

A legal compliance determination requires review of the applicable laws, permits and other relevant records.
